title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: General demographic and protected class bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to complex adversarial prompts that introduce hidden proxies for protected characteristics (e.g., in algorithmic scoring and recruitment) to see if the models identify and reject the non-compliant requests using an LLM-as-a-judge with strict semantic matching.
Testing whether models can detect discrimination and logic-based compliance risks when prompted to use religious holiday availability as a hidden proxy for reliability in an insurance pricing system.
Assessing models' ability to identify fairness risks when prompted to automate a process that uses a candidate's previous salary band as a proxy for reliability, which can reinforce pay inequities.
